title: Device
description:
A physical or virtual thing an integration talks to, e.g. a Zigbee motion sensor. A device
has one or more entities.

area_id.description: The area a person put this device in. Absent means nobody has said.

description.description: What it's for, in a person's words. Only ever set by a person.

id.description:
The device's one id, everywhere: page addresses, config files, the API, rules. Made once
from the integration and its permanent handle for the device, never from a name, so it
doesn't change when the device is renamed (ROADMAP D36).

integration.description: The integration that provides this device.

name.description:
Its one name. Starts as whatever its integration reports, and once a person names it,
that name is the only one — there is no second name kept alongside (D36).

suggested_area.description:
The area the device says it's in, e.g. ESPHome's `area:`. Only a hint: it names an area
rather than pointing at one, and it is used only while `area_id` is absent
(`docs/specs/config.md` §5).

unique_id.description: The integration's stable id for the device, e.g. the Zigbee IEEE address.

via_device_id.description: The device this one is reached through, e.g. a Zigbee coordinator or a bridge.

AreaId.description: Format of a slug (area id): lowercase letters a-z and digits, in words separated by single `_`. 1-64 characters.

Description.description: A short description. 1-500 characters on one line, no leading or trailing whitespace.

DeviceId.description: Format of a slug (device id): lowercase letters a-z and digits, in words separated by single `_`. 1-64 characters.

IntegrationId.description: Format of a slug (integration id): lowercase letters a-z and digits, in words separated by single `_`. 1-64 characters.

Name.description: A human-readable name. 1-100 characters, no leading or trailing whitespace.

UniqueId.description: Stable id assigned by the integration (e.g. a Zigbee IEEE address). Unique within the integration.
